Servant Leadership
Leadership is not about commanding, it’s about
serving.
If you want the best in your e ecal team, 1, you you nave have to to give
your best.
Brilliant Servant Leadership Cheat Sheet from
Victoria Repa
Want the highest performance?
L Provide them with the best resources and
opportunities.
Want a change in quality?
4 Give them quality feedback.
Want improved productivity?
‘, Let them recharge properly and give them better
rest.
Want growth within your team?
‣, Serve them with effective mentorship and the
right learning resources
Want more wins and achievements?
‣ Celebrate with them. Any compliment can go a
long way.
A leader isn’t at the top of the pyramid.
They are the one who treats everyone as if they
are at the top.
Are you a servant leader?

item.title: HackMD
item.author: emecas
item.description:
HackMD
https://hackmd.io/home#
Get everyone on the same page with Markdown
Real-time collaborate on [personal | team | professional | technical | project ] documentation in markdown. Capture fleeting ideas and formalize tribal knowledge. 44

Effective team collaboration
Flexible permissioning

Transcend beyond space and time
Blazing fast real-time collaboration breaks the space between members. Change notification keeps everyone posted.
Sharing is caring
Team workspace for bird’s-eye view over all team documents. Shared templates keep format and styling consistent.
Keep your secret (while sharing it)
Granular note permission settings and private image storage give you full control over how and with whom you share.

item.title: tilt
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Tilt
https://tilt.dev/
Tilt Up and Get Stuff Done
Tilt manages local development instances for teams that deploy to Kubernetes.

Transition easily from any setup
Tilt is super fast to set up for greenfield projects, but it really shines when your setup requires some “extra love”
(and even then it’s still pretty quick!) Any setup, any architecture, no matter how complex. Any engineer can run tilt up to see the app live instantly.
